# Partiful — account brief

## Who
Partiful describes itself as "Delightful, free party invites. Plan events and parties with friends." ([source](https://partiful.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is committed in partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- The app runs react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows checked in ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- A second org, partiful-app, has eas.json in mobile-legacy ([source](https://github.com/partiful-app/mobile-legacy/blob/main/eas.json)).
- The org has 12 public repos and 180 followers ([source](https://github.com/partiful)).
- The iOS listing has 41,200 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)).
- Six App Store releases shipped in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)).
- An open issue reads "eas update rollout stuck at 0% for Android channel" ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@partiful-maintainer-1), top contributor to partiful/mobile with 142 commits ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)). The profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)). No title or location is listed.
- Maintainer Two (@partiful-maintainer-2), 87 commits to partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-2)). The profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-2)). No title or location is listed.
- Maintainer Three (@partiful-maintainer-3), 31 commits to partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-3)). The profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-3)). No title or location is listed.

## Why now
partiful/mobile was last pushed on 2026-08-14 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile)), and six App Store releases went out in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)). The app is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
You have 142 commits in partiful/mobile, which builds through EAS on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)). There is an open issue on the repo about an eas update rollout stuck at 0% for an Android channel ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)), and six store releases went out in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)). When that Android rollout stalled, what did you do next: hold the channel, or cut a new store build?
